(I had to rewrite this unfortunately, there was a little glitch i couldn't post on your wall so if it spammed im sorry)

So I made some portraits for some US presidents like Reed Chen and Dan Forest. For Reed Chen, I made two versions; The Original and the Blank. Personally, now that I am typing this, I think that the Blank version is good but I want to see what you think first. I made some changes to the blank compared to the Original. The original had a bit bad lighting, the angle is off, and it's kind of blurry (and the nose is a little hard to do) so the face is a bit meh.

(Blank) http://i.imgur.com/BHxUAbU.png

(Original) http://i.imgur.com/813AzLD.png

The one below is Dan Forest, tbh I actually imagined him with a square jaw and my mind wandered towards Mike Pence. But I did modified the silhouete.

http://i.imgur.com/y3x6aOx.png

So what do you think?
